name: gauth
description: Manage Google OAuth tokens for nSelf AI services: status, refresh, and revoke against plugin-gauth.
author: nself

actions.status: Show token expiry for all provisioned gauth accounts
actions.refresh: Force-refresh a specific account's access token
actions.revoke: Revoke and remove a stored refresh token

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables. It is a thin HTTP client to the paid plugin-gauth backend service (plugins-pro/paid/plugin-gauth, port 3762, requires_license=true) — the CLI surface itself has zero license checks, matching the Three-Surface Model (App/client tier is always free; only the backend bundle is paid). Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/gauth.go under CLI-R11; zero internal/* imports in the original file, so this is a verbatim move, not an adaptation.
